title: A Signal for the Protocol
author: Freya Thackeray
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
